<Accordion title="Week 5 — 09/21/2026" subtitle="Timeline check-in and Senior Design document">

**Location:** Zoom, 5:00 PM
**Led by:** Dr. Mayra Socarras
**Purpose:** Check in on progress and the proposal timeline, and introduce the Senior Design document.

**1. Timeline**

- Dr. Socarras told the team to stay observant of the timeline stated in the proposal so as not to lose time.
- The team explained that some activities had been switched around based on priorities, and that the mechanical part's time requirements had probably been underestimated, so the Gantt chart will eventually need to be revised.

**2. Senior Design Document**

- Dr. Socarras told the team to start working on the first draft of the Senior Design document, incorporating the latest changes.
- This is a task for this week.

**3. Progress Update**

- The team communicated its progress to Dr. Socarras, based on the team's logs.

</Accordion>
